props.name: name
props.comment: The resource name (matches a `<Resource name>` registered in `<Admin>`).

props.name: label
props.comment: Override the label. Defaults to the pluralized resource label.

props.name: icon
props.comment: Override the icon. Defaults to the resource's registry icon or a list glyph.

props.name: onClick
props.comment: Click handler invoked alongside the default navigation (e.g. close the drawer).
